面向 Google Antigravity 的原生工程工作流插件：五阶段硬门禁、权限物理隔离的子智能体、Neon High 顾问参谋与推前盲审及 33 个精选工程技能。

[English](./README.en.md) · **简体中文** · [模型选型基准](./docs/benchmarks-2026-11.md) · [五阶段工程模式](./docs/power-user-patterns.md) · [早期 Hermes 迁移归档](./docs/legacy-hermes.md)
--- 写复杂项目时，只靠“在提示词里多写几句小心点”根本拦不住两类翻车： 一是**权限与上下文混在一起**。主窗口一边自己读几千行文件烧光上下文，一边又让多个子任务同时往同一个工作区写代码，最后冲突到只能整体回滚。 二是**同源模型自改自审**。写代码的模型和对话线程自己点通过，往往看不到漏做的边界、私货改动，或者只测了 mock 的空壳单测。 这个插件仓库直接把约束做进 Antigravity 的原生结构里： 1. **工具层物理隔离与 `PreToolUse` 硬拦截**：主脑（`Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`）只管方案定稿与耦合核心；[`agents/scout.md`](./agents/scout.md) 物理剥离 `edit_file` / `write_file` 权限；根目录 [`hooks.json`](./hooks.json) + [`scripts/guard-hook.mjs`](./scripts/guard-hook.mjs) 在 `PreToolUse` 按真实命令词法硬拦截 `Co-Authored-By`、`@codex review`、裸 `git push --force`/`+ref`、`--body-file` 与 `gh api -F body=@file` 的 UTF-8/UTF-16 BOM 及异常控制字符，以及测试内 `node:vm`/`eval`/`new Function`（不误拦只读 `gh` 或本地临时目录路径）。 2. **S/M/L 分级快车道 + 五阶段硬门禁（Stage 0 – Stage 4）**：单文件文案/配置走 S 级免仪式快车道；中大型改动走全套门禁——先 `how` + `why` + `architect` 定界（高风险分叉或连修卡死调只读 [`agents/advisor.md`](./agents/advisor.md)），再 `systematic-debugging` + `test-value` + `correct` 施工，推前过 `interrogate` 实证对抗与只读 [`agents/reviewer.md`](./agents/reviewer.md)（默认绑定 `Gemini 4 Neon (High)`；主会话同为 Neon High 且属高风险改动时自动切异构模型）。 3. **开箱即用与自动校验/同步**：仓库根目录即完整插件包（[`plugin.json`](./plugin.json) + [`hooks.json`](./hooks.json) + [`rules/AGENTS.md`](./rules/AGENTS.md) + [`agents/`](./agents) + 33 个扁平 [`skills/`](./skills)），附带跨平台校验 [`scripts/verify-plugin.mjs`](./scripts/verify-plugin.mjs) 与不覆盖本地私有规则的双向同步 [`scripts/sync-workflow.mjs`](./scripts/sync-workflow.mjs)。
--- ## 最快上手 ### 方式一：直接克隆为 Antigravity 全局插件（推荐） 仓库根目录就是标准 Antigravity 插件布局，直接克隆到 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/workflow` 即可被自动发现并启用： ```bash git clone https://github.com/dreamfarer-space/multi-model-agent-workflow.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/workflow ``` ### 方式二：通过安装脚本同步（也支持导出技能到其他工具） ```bash git clone https://github.com/dreamfarer-space/multi-model-agent-workflow.git cd multi-model-agent-workflow # 安装完整 Antigravity 插件（默认保留本地已有 rules/AGENTS.md，设 FORCE_RULES=1 可覆盖） bash scripts/install-skills.sh --target antigravity # 或使用跨平台 Node 脚本同步核心文件与 33 个公共技能（兼容 Windows PowerShell，绝不覆盖私有规则） node scripts/sync-workflow.mjs --to-local # 运行插件完整性、SVG 边界、脱敏与 Hook 行为自检 node scripts/verify-plugin.mjs # 如需同时将 33 个扁平 Skill 同步到其他代理目录： # bash scripts/install-skills.sh --target claude # ~/.claude/skills # bash scripts/install-skills.sh --target cursor # ~/.cursor/skills # bash scripts/install-skills.sh --target agents # ~/.agents/skills ``` > 早期的 `Hermes Agent × Magpie` 多账号轮询方案已归档至 [`docs/legacy-hermes.md`](./docs/legacy-hermes.md)。 --- ## Antigravity 模型与代理分工 | 角色 | 推荐模型 / 原生入口 | 核心职责与硬约束 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **主脑统筹（Plan / Execute）** | `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`
`/plan` · `/grill-me` · `/boost` | 需求收敛、`architect` 两版骨架定稿、强耦合核心修改、最终验收；主会话禁止连续超过 30 次独自读写文件。 | | **只读静态侦察** | `invoke_subagent(TypeName="research")` | 纯源码静态阅读与跨目录符号检索（无网络无终端沙盒），返回 `≤50` 行摘要附精确 `file:line`。 | | **只读 + CLI 考古/复现** | `invoke_subagent(TypeName="scout")`
（[`agents/scout.md`](./agents/scout.md)） | 仅授予 `read_file`、`run_command`、`manage_task`、`search_web`，物理剥离写工具；用于 `why`、`how` 与 Phase 1 失败复现。 | | **并行施工与分片流水线** | `invoke_subagent(TypeName="self", Workspace="share" \| "branch")`
`run_workflow` | 独立模块编码、回归测试与多语言包同步；单批并发 **≤5 路**，派发后等待系统唤醒，禁止循环轮询。 | | **技术顾问 / 方案参谋** | `swarm` (`gemini-4-neon-high`)
回退：`invoke_subagent(TypeName="advisor", Model="pro")` | `brief` 首行强制要求先 `read_file` [`agents/advisor.md`](./agents/advisor.md)：严格只读，提供架构权衡、高风险方案第二意见与卡死重规划，出结论后立即 `swarm kill`。 | | **推前独立四维盲审** | `swarm` (`gemini-4-neon-high`；主脑同为 Neon High 的高风险改动切异构模型如 `claude-opus-5-5-high`)
回退：`invoke_subagent(TypeName="reviewer", Model="pro")` | `brief` 首行强制要求先 `read_file` [`agents/reviewer.md`](./agents/reviewer.md)：不传聊天历史，只读完整 `git diff` 与测试输出，过 4 维审校出 `PASS` 才准 push，结论后立即 `swarm kill`。 | | **极端死锁单回合急救** | `claude-opus-5-5` | 连续两轮修复同一 Bug 失败后立即停手，切过去单回合外科定位根因。 | 详细模型基准对照见 [2026-11 模型选型基准](./docs/benchmarks-2026-11.md)。 --- ## 五阶段硬门禁工程流（Stage 0 – Stage 4）
规则已固化在 [`rules/AGENTS.md`](./rules/AGENTS.md) 中，深层实践见 [五阶段工程模式拆解](./docs/power-user-patterns.md)： 1. **Stage 0 · 接单立界**：核对目标仓 `AGENTS.md` 与上游基线，**禁止在主工作区直接切分支**（必建独立 `worktree`）；先跑 `how` 摸清调用链，改旧防御逻辑前跑 `why` 查 git/PR 历史意图，跨模块先用 `architect` 画两套骨架，分叉需求用 `grill-me`（配合 `ask_question`）锁死边界与 `Out of Scope`。 2. **Stage 1 · 定位与施工**：修 Bug 先跑 `systematic-debugging` 建最小失败复现，未知可行性先做一次性 `spike`；写测试遵守 `test-value`（答清“什么错会挂 / 会不会误伤重构 / 是否有重复覆盖”，**严禁在测试中引入 `node:vm` / `eval` / `new Function`**）；重复踩过的坑用 `correct` 按“架构 → 类型 → Lint → 行为测试 → 文档”最高层级固化；冗余代码用 `simplify-codebase` 按证据删减。 3. **Stage 2 · 本地门禁与独立终审**：先 `git fetch && git rebase` 对齐基线并重编产物，串行跑通 `check` 与测试；高风险并发/权限/协议改动加跑 `interrogate`（只保留真实命令复现出来的缺陷）；改动 **≥2 个源码文件**或触及 **状态机 / 权限 / 安全 / 协议 / IPC / 日志脱敏**，push 前强制调用 `reviewer` 过四维盲审（边界私货、安全与脱敏、`test-value` 鉴别力、废话注释与 `@ts-ignore`/`eslint-disable` 清理）。 4. **Stage 3 · 规范提 PR**：匹配目标仓库主语言与 PR 模板（`yeet` / `github`），正文一律写为**无 BOM UTF-8** `--body-file` 提交；严禁添加 AI `Co-Authored-By` 或擅自触发自动审查机器人；调试截图禁入源码主干且严禁暴露本机用户名与绝对路径。 5. **Stage 4 · 推后巡检与评论闭环**：push 后立刻查 `gh pr view --json mergeStateStatus`（遇 `DIRTY` 立即解冲突重推防跳过 CI）与 `gh pr checks`（失败走 `gh-fix-ci`）；收到评审意见走 `gh-address-comments` 在原 thread 回复并显式执行 GraphQL `resolveReviewThread`，合入后用 `--delete-branch` 清理分支。 ---

规则已固化在 [`rules/AGENTS.md`](./rules/AGENTS.md) 中，深层实践见 [五阶段工程模式拆解](./docs/power-user-patterns.md)： 1. **Stage 0 · 接单立界**：核对目标仓 `AGENTS.md` 与上游基线，**禁止在主工作区直接切分支**（必建独立 `worktree`）；先跑 `how` 摸清调用链，改旧防御逻辑前跑 `why` 查 git/PR 历史意图，跨模块先用 `architect` 画两套骨架，分叉需求用 `grill-me`（配合 `ask_question`）锁死边界与 `Out of Scope`。 2. **Stage 1 · 定位与施工**：修 Bug 先跑 `systematic-debugging` 建最小失败复现，未知可行性先做一次性 `spike`；写测试遵守 `test-value`（答清“什么错会挂 / 会不会误伤重构 / 是否有重复覆盖”，**严禁在测试中引入 `node:vm` / `eval` / `new Function`**）；重复踩过的坑用 `correct` 按“架构 → 类型 → Lint → 行为测试 → 文档”最高层级固化；冗余代码用 `simplify-codebase` 按证据删减。 3. **Stage 2 · 本地门禁与独立终审**：先 `git fetch && git rebase` 对齐基线并重编产物，串行跑通 `check` 与测试；高风险并发/权限/协议改动加跑 `interrogate`（只保留真实命令复现出来的缺陷）；改动 **≥2 个源码文件**或触及 **状态机 / 权限 / 安全 / 协议 / IPC / 日志脱敏**，push 前强制调用 `reviewer` 过四维盲审（边界私货、安全与脱敏、`test-value` 鉴别力、废话注释与 `@ts-ignore`/`eslint-disable` 清理）。 4. **Stage 3 · 规范提 PR**：匹配目标仓库主语言与 PR 模板（`yeet` / `github`），正文一律写为**无 BOM UTF-8** `--body-file` 提交；严禁添加 AI `Co-Authored-By` 或擅自触发自动审查机器人；调试截图禁入源码主干且严禁暴露本机用户名与绝对路径。 5. **Stage 4 · 推后巡检与评论闭环**：push 后立刻查 `gh pr view --json mergeStateStatus`（遇 `DIRTY` 立即解冲突重推防跳过 CI）与 `gh pr checks`（失败走 `gh-fix-ci`）；收到评审意见走 `gh-address-comments` 在原 thread 回复并显式执行 GraphQL `resolveReviewThread`，合入后用 `--delete-branch` 清理分支。 ---

A native Google Antigravity engineering workflow plugin: 5-stage hard gates, write-stripped scout / advisor / reviewer subagents, Neon High advisor & blind audit, and 33 curated skills.

**English** · [简体中文](./README.md) · [Model Benchmarks](./docs/benchmarks-2026-11.md) · [Engineering Patterns](./docs/power-user-patterns.md) · [Legacy Hermes Archive](./docs/legacy-hermes.md)
--- Prompt reminders alone fail on large codebases in two predictable ways: First, mixing reconnaissance and coupled edits in one thread burns flagship context while concurrent writers trample the same files. Second, self-review suffers from confirmation bias: the same model and chat thread that wrote a patch routinely overlooks skipped requirements, unrequested scope additions, and hollow mock tests. This repository packages the constraints directly into Antigravity's native plugin structure: 1. **Tool-level isolation & `PreToolUse` hard hooks**: The lead model (`Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`) owns planning and coupled core edits; [`agents/scout.md`](./agents/scout.md) physically strips `edit_file` / `write_file`; root [`hooks.json`](./hooks.json) + [`scripts/guard-hook.mjs`](./scripts/guard-hook.mjs) parse actual command invocations before execution to hard-block AI `Co-Authored-By`, `@codex review`, bare `git push --force`/`+ref`, UTF-8/UTF-16 BOM or stray control characters in `--body-file` / `gh api -F body=@file`, and `node:vm`/`eval`/`new Function` in tests (without false positives on read-only `gh` or local temp paths). 2. **S/M/L task tiering + 5-stage hard-gated pipeline (Stage 0 – Stage 4)**: Single-file docs/config tweaks take the S-tier fast lane; M/L work runs the full gate — ground with `how` + `why` + `architect` (consult read-only [`agents/advisor.md`](./agents/advisor.md) on forks/deadlocks), build with `systematic-debugging` + `test-value` + `correct`, verify before push with `interrogate` and read-only [`agents/reviewer.md`](./agents/reviewer.md) (pinned to `Gemini 4 Neon (High)`, switching to a heterogeneous model such as `claude-opus-5-5-high` when the lead session itself is Neon High on high-risk edits). 3. **Ready-to-use plugin + automated verification/sync**: The repository root is a valid plugin (`plugin.json` + `hooks.json` + `rules/AGENTS.md` + `agents/` + 33 flat `skills/`), backed by cross-platform [`scripts/verify-plugin.mjs`](./scripts/verify-plugin.mjs) and non-destructive [`scripts/sync-workflow.mjs`](./scripts/sync-workflow.mjs).
--- ## Quickstart ### Option 1: Clone directly as an Antigravity global plugin (Recommended) ```bash git clone https://github.com/dreamfarer-space/multi-model-agent-workflow.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/workflow ``` ### Option 2: Install via script (also exports skills to other tools) ```bash git clone https://github.com/dreamfarer-space/multi-model-agent-workflow.git cd multi-model-agent-workflow # Install full Antigravity plugin (preserves existing local rules/AGENTS.md unless FORCE_RULES=1) bash scripts/install-skills.sh --target antigravity # Or use cross-platform Node sync (works on Windows PowerShell, preserves local private rules) node scripts/sync-workflow.mjs --to-local # Run automated plugin, SVG bounds, sanitization, and guard-hook behavioral checks node scripts/verify-plugin.mjs # Or export the 33 flat skills to another skill directory: # bash scripts/install-skills.sh --target claude # ~/.claude/skills # bash scripts/install-skills.sh --target cursor # ~/.cursor/skills # bash scripts/install-skills.sh --target agents # ~/.agents/skills ``` > Historical `Hermes Agent × Magpie` routing configs have been archived in [`docs/legacy-hermes.md`](./docs/legacy-hermes.md). --- ## Antigravity Model & Subagent Roles | Role | Recommended Model / Entrypoint | Scope & Guardrails | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Lead (Plan / Execute)** | `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`

Enforced in [`rules/AGENTS.md`](./rules/AGENTS.md) and unpacked in [Engineering Patterns](./docs/power-user-patterns.md): 1. **Stage 0 · Scope & Grounding**: Check target `AGENTS.md` and upstream baseline, **never branch directly in the main workspace** (use an isolated `git worktree`); ground with `how` and `why` before touching safeguards, sketch two distinct shapes with `architect`, and lock decisions + `Out of Scope` with `grill-me` / `ask_question`. 2. **Stage 1 · Locate, Implement & Guard**: Build a tight failing loop first with `systematic-debugging` (or throwaway `spike`); follow `test-value` (**strict ban on `node:vm` / `eval` / `new Function` in tests**); fix recurring mistake classes at the highest effective level with `correct` (Architecture → Types → Lint → Behavioral Tests → Docs); trim accidental complexity with `simplify-codebase`. 3. **Stage 2 · Local Gates & Pre-Push Audit**: Fetch and rebase onto upstream, rebuild artifacts, and run local checks/tests sequentially; run `interrogate` on high-risk concurrency/auth/protocol edits (only command-proven findings survive); trigger read-only `reviewer` whenever ≥2 source files or state-machine/permission/security/IPC/redaction paths change. 4. **Stage 3 · Clean PR Delivery**: Follow repository templates (`yeet` / `github`), write `--body-file` in **BOM-free UTF-8**, match the repo's primary language, never add AI `Co-Authored-By` trailers or unsolicited review bots, and keep screenshots redacted and out of source branches. 5. **Stage 4 · Post-Push CI & Review Loop**: Inspect `gh pr view --json mergeStateStatus` immediately (rebase if `DIRTY` so CI isn't skipped), shepherd `gh pr checks` + `gh-fix-ci`, and resolve feedback via `gh-address-comments` by replying in-thread and executing GraphQL `resolveReviewThread`, cleaning up branches with `--delete-branch` after merge. ---
